evidence_excerpt: transformation of hotel rooms as intelligent rooms that tunes itself to the preferences of the guest through machine learning and Artificial Intelligence
evidence_summary: Emaar Hospitality Group announced an organisation-wide digital transformation and said it had launched three initiatives, one centered on AI/ML-powered intelligent hotel rooms; the disclosure does not clearly establish completed production deployment at specific properties in 2018.
source_locator: Official Emaar press release, April 2018 > A focus on digitisation
adoption_interpretation: Pre-deployment/launch evidence at the start of the panel. Do not assign operational adoption from this record alone.
notes: Conservative score 1 because the initiative is described prospectively even though the digital programme itself had been launched.

evidence_excerpt: successfully completed the installation of the Winnow system in five of its premier properties in 2023
evidence_summary: Emaar's official sustainability site states that Emaar Hospitality installed an AI-enabled Winnow system at five hotels in 2023; cameras and machine learning identify and record food waste to support kitchen waste management and cost control.
source_locator: Emaar Sustainability > Our Stories > Harnessing AI for Sustainability at Emaar Hospitality
adoption_interpretation: First observed clearly completed AI deployment in the currently audited Emaar Properties material. Earlier reports still require the same manual search, so true adoption is left-censored at <=2023 rather than fixed to 2023.
notes: Score 2: real deployment at five operating properties is explicit; food-waste management is operational but not sufficient by itself for core score 3.

evidence_excerpt: Emaar Smart Home ... featuring the latest AI-powered smart home products from Xiaomi
evidence_summary: Emaar and Xiaomi announced a smart-home product planned to launch in 2020 with pre-installed AI-powered and IoT products, but the cited announcement is an MoU/launch plan rather than evidence of completed customer deployment.
adoption_interpretation: Intent/product-launch evidence only; not used as treatment onset without a later source confirming delivery or operational use.
notes: Frozen codebook does not treat an MoU or announced future rollout as deployment.
